title: Cell-free 3PGA Energy Solution Preparation
author: Nadanai Laohakunakorn
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8pshvne
materials: Make stock solution of other components
Weigh out and make the following stock solutions. Four species require titration; their pH can be approximately measured by spotting 1 uL on appropriate pH paper.
Weigh tyrosine and add to a separate tube

steps.title: Weigh non‑tyrosine amino acids
steps.instruction: Weigh each amino acid (excluding tyrosine) on parafilm, record the weight, and combine all powders in a single tube. Optional: weigh at 10 × scale to simplify handling.

steps.title: Dissolve amino acids to 50 mM
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL deionized water to the tube, vortex to mix, then adjust pH to ~5.2 with approximately 80 µL of 1 M KOH (total water 920 µL). If powder does not fully dissolve, add up to ~50 µL more 1 M KOH. Check pH (≈5.2‑8) with pH paper and keep the solution on ice.

steps.title: Prepare tyrosine stock
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL of 1 mM KOH to the tyrosine powder and vortex until as dissolved as possible. Then add 50 µL of 15 % KOH, vortex, add 50 µL deionized water, vortex again, and measure pH (≈11‑12). Keep the solution on ice.

steps.title: Store amino‑acid and tyrosine stocks
steps.instruction: Aliquot each stock into storage tubes (25 µL recommended), optionally flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 2 M Tris base stock
steps.instruction: Make a 2 M stock solution of Tris base (details of preparation not provided in the source).

steps.title: Prepare KOH stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 M KOH stock solution and a 15 % (w/v) KOH stock solution (details not provided in the source).

steps.title: Assemble 4× energy solution
steps.instruction: Add all components (amino‑acid stock, tyrosine stock, and other reagents) to a tube in any order, vortex after each addition, and keep the tube on ice. This 4× solution will constitute 25 % of the final reaction volume.

steps.title: Adjust pH and aliquot final solution
steps.instruction: Measure the pH of the 4× energy solution with pH paper (target ≈8). Aliquot 25 µL into storage tubes, optionally flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Optional Mg‑/K‑glutamate optimization
steps.instruction: For calibration, omit PEG, Mg‑glutamate, and K‑glutamate, then combine the remaining components to a total volume of 731.33 µL. Aliquot into ten tubes of 73.13 µL each. Literature reports optimal concentrations of 4.5‑10.5 mM Mg‑glutamate (or 12 mM) and 40‑160 mM K‑glutamate (or 130 mM).
